targets.baseline_commit_message: file-spoken-moments-into-topic-buckets: the launch-video cloud-results moment cutter, moved byte for byte

preserve: a transcript of fewer than three words is skipped
identical transcript texts (by a 16-byte blake2b of the text) are cut once; the copies are named in duplicates
a transcript's source is b2 or r2 by its file's origin in the store (alias first, else the 1f: identity of the same hash), else drive-only

the text is cut at sentence ends into moments of at most 120 words, and each moment's place is estimated from its share of the characters: frac_start, frac_end, and est_start, est_end when the duration is known
each moment keeps the transcript's name, path, media kind and duration from its library entry and facts
the coverage: moments per source, distinct transcripts per source and media kind, and hours of media with known duration
allowed_deltas: the cloud results copy, the store (the files door's answer as --held JSON, or a namespace sqlite copy), the output file and the moment length are arguments
duplicates now names the copies: the old script wrote each moment before its copies were found, so its duplicates were always empty
the coverage the second script printed is part of the answer, {"result": {...}}, read from the moments as they are written
banned_substitutions: a store path or drive written in code
_paths: The source lives in a private repository, so it is named by the BLAKE3 identity of its path (path_multihash); a checkout of that repository beside this one finds it.
